summary: The registrant files Form 6-K to disclose the completion of an additional closing under a securities purchase agreement previously announced on May 4, 2026. The company issued 3,600,000 Class A ordinary shares at $2.40 per share (post 10-for-1 share consolidation) for gross proceeds of $8,640,000, following an initial closing of $3,360,000. The offering was made under an effective F-3 registration statement and board-approved. The filing reflects a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. No extraordinary event is present; it is a standard follow-on placement.
